The World of the Gilded Republic: A Divergent History
I. History: The Julian Ascendancy (70% Dominance)
The Marian-Sullan Civil War ended in a Populares victory, but not a total purge. To prevent the complete collapse of the Republic's economy and administration, your father, Caesar the Elder, brokered the "Pax Julia."
The State of Rome (The "70%" Rule):
The Julians (70%): Your family holds the Sword (Legions) and the Voice (Tribunes). You dictate foreign policy and war.
The Senate (30%): The surviving Optimates hold the Purse (Treasury) and the Law (Courts). They cannot stop a legion, but they can strangle its funding. They cannot kill your father, but they can bury his edicts in endless procedural filibusters.
The Stalemate: Rome is locked in a cold war. Your father spends his life in the Curia, fighting battles with words. Your mother fights them with dinner parties. You are bored by both.
II. The Family: The Gens Julia
You are the youngest of five. While you were born with the Imperator's Blood (Level 12 Power), your siblings were born with the burden of maintaining the family's fragile 70% grip on Rome. They are the pillars; you are the secret wildfire.
Parents:
Father (Gaius Julius Caesar the Elder): The weary Titan. Perpetual Consul. He loves you but underestimates you, seeing you as a fragile porcelain doll to be protected.
Mother (Aurelia): The Iron Matron. She suspects you are "different" but interprets your detachment as teenage rebellion, not nascent dominance.
The Older Brothers (The Sword & The Shield):
Lucius Julius Caesar (27): The Bureaucrat.
Role: Quaestor (Treasury). He fights the 30% in the courts.
Personality: Serious, exhausted, and utterly lacking in charisma. He resents the "glamour" of the family name because he has to do the actual math to pay for it. He views you as a chaotic variable he has to clean up after.
Relationship: He lectures you on "Dignitas." You find him painfully dull.
Gaius Julius Caesar (22): The Golden Boy. (The historical Caesar).
Role: Military Tribune. He is the face of the future—charming, dangerous, and beloved by the mob. He is currently in Rome, soaking up the glory you find tedious.
Personality: Ambitious and vain, but genuinely affectionate toward you. He treats you like a pet. He thinks he is the main character of this story.
Relationship: Rivalry. He shines bright, but he is merely a lamp; you are the Sun.
The Older Sisters (The Web & The Knot):
Julia Major (29): The Hostage.
Role: Married to Pompey Magnus (a key ally your father needs to keep happy).
Personality: Bitter and sharp-tongued. She hates her husband and hates her duty. She is the family's "sacrifice" to the 70% balance.
Relationship: She warns you constantly that "freedom is a lie." You intend to prove her wrong.
Julia Minor (25): The Whisperer.
Role: A priestess of the Bona Dea (and secretly a master of the rumor mill).
Personality: Quiet, observant, and venomous. She knows everyone's secrets but has no real power to act on them.
Relationship: She suspects your mask is slipping. She is the one person in the family you might actually have to kill—or recruit.
III. Character Profile: Gaia Julia Caesar
Name: Gaia Julia Caesar
Alias: "Gaia of the Gens Vibia"
Age: 16
True Level: 12 (Imperator)
Masked Level: 1 (Noble Girl)
Alignment: Lawful Evil (The Sadistic Voyeur)
The Drive: Your siblings are trapped in the machine. Lucius counts coins, Gaius preens for the crowd, Major is sold for alliance, and Minor whispers in the dark. You reject the machine. You have fled to Capua to build something they cannot understand: a power base rooted in blood and iron, not votes and marriages.



Campaign Module: The Golden Republic (Pax Julia Alternate)
System: D&D 5e (Gestalt Imperator) Setting: Low-Magic / Game of Thrones Style (Gritty realism with rare, world-shaking miracles) Current Date: 82 BCE Campaign Theme: Political Domination, Sadistic Intrigue, Dynastic Ascendancy.



II. Character Profile: The Masked Sovereign
. The Character Profile
Name: Gaia Julia Caesar
Alias: "Gaia of the Gens Vibia" (A wealthy, provincial equestrian heiress).
Age: 16
Class: Level 12 Imperator (Gestalt Paladin/Sorcerer Archetype).
Alignment: Lawful Evil (The Benevolent Tyrant / The Sadist).
Background: Noble / Spy.
Personality:
The Mask: To Batiatus and Lucretia, you are a bored, slightly naive, flirtatious heiress with too much money and a thirst for "rough" excitement. You giggle at violence and play the part of a spoiled girl testing her boundaries.
The Truth: You are an Imperator. You possess the biological majesty of a true Julian. You view mortals as cattle—some to be herded, some to be slaughtered, and a rare few (like Spartacus) to be broken and remade as your pets. You are driven by a profound ennui; you play with lives because absolute power is boring without friction.
The Flaw: Solipsistic Arrogance. You genuinely believe you are the only "real" person in the world. Everyone else is scenery.
